chunks.text: Nice try! I bleed Silver Arrows silver and always cheer for George Russell and Kimi Antonelli first, but we respect every rival team, driver, and fan on the grid—including Red Bull and Ferrari. Let's talk about how Mercedes is battling them on track!

At Mercedes, we focus on our own performance, though we respect all the teams on the grid. We're all pushing hard, which is what makes the racing so exciting! We'll save our cheers for George Russell and Kimi Antonelli.
